scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:web
scripts.dev:rust: cargo-watch --watch core/src --watch wasm/src -s 'wasm-pack build wasm --target bundler --dev'
scripts.dev: bun run dev:rust & bun run dev:web
scripts.test:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace && cargo test
scripts.test:logic: bun run build:wasm && bun run --cwd logic test
scripts.test:mutation: bun run build:wasm && bun run --cwd logic test:mutation
scripts.test:web: bun run build:wasm && bun run --cwd web test
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun run --cwd web test:e2e
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:rust && bun run --cwd logic test && bun run --cwd web test && bun run --cwd web test:e2e
